articles.title: Why a 'Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark' Sequel Is Stuck in Legal Limbo
articles.summary: Director André Øvredal says a sequel to 'Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark' is ready to go, but the rights are tangled because the two original studios no longer exist.

articles.title: A Sleeping Mother Nature Wins Top Prize at Chelsea Flower Show
articles.summary: A giant sleeping figure of Gaia, made from a fallen tree and willow branches, won Garden of the Year at the Chelsea Flower Show. The garden highlights the beauty of overlooked 'edgelands.'

articles.title: Rio2C: Latin America's Biggest Creativity Festival Bridges Borders
articles.summary: Rio2C, Latin America's largest creativity gathering, expects record attendance of 55,000+ this year. It's focusing on connecting Brazil's creative industry with Spanish-speaking Latin American countries.
